Contributor: ITineris Discussion Comment No.: 4 Comment: Elővettem a trackeket. A Bohóc kúttól délre nem volt meg az RTK vétel. (Futókör, körönd, Magyar Zene Háza körüli gumók rendben.) Ugyanakkor azt látom, hogy a garantáltan RTK-s részeken, a léghajós játszótér és a sportpályák épületeinél is van legalább ekkora elcsúszás az Esrin. December elején tudok kimenni RTK-val ellenőrizni ezt a részt. (És igazán korrekt az lenne, ha a gumók között levő járatokat is berajzolnám footway-ként.) Date: 2025-11-21T18:07:36+01:00

Contributor: balint36 Discussion Comment No.: 1 Comment: Hello, I noticed that in your recent edits at BUD (LHBP) you added several aircraft parking positions as ways. However, these positions already existed as nodes, so this resulted in duplication. For example, the R211 stand is now present both as a node (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/2199880505) and as a way (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/1429981655). Could you please clarify if there is a particular reason why these positions needed to be created as ways instead of keeping the existing nodes? At other airports (such as CDG) I have not seen this kind of duplication, so it seems specific to your edits. If there is no strong reason to keep both representations, I would plan to remove the duplicates to maintain consistency. Date: 2025-11-19T22:38:18+01:00
